scripts.check:engines: node -e "const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process'); if (process.version !== 'v26.2.0') process.exit(1); if (execFileSync('pnpm', ['--version'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim() !== '11.20.0') process.exit(1)"
scripts.check: pnpm check:engines && biome check . && pnpm --filter @rehow/desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @rehow/contracts typecheck && pnpm contracts:check
scripts.test: pnpm check:engines && pnpm --filter @rehow/desktop test && cargo test --workspace --all-targets --locked
scripts.build: pnpm check:engines && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm --filter @rehow/contracts build && pnpm --filter @rehow/desktop build && cargo build --workspace --locked
